label: Live reported threat activity from public feeds
cache_note: This is a cached report built by the fetch job. It is not a live attack stream.
sample_note: The report list keeps the newest rows from each feed, up to a cap. Country totals and the unfiltered 24 hour chart use the full parse.

feeds.name: abuse.ch URLhaus
feeds.licence: Free to use with attribution to abuse.ch. See the project terms.
feeds.role_note: Recent malware URLs. A mapped country is the DB-IP country of an IP literal in the URL, not a victim.

feeds.name: abuse.ch ThreatFox
feeds.licence: Free to use with attribution to abuse.ch. See the project terms.
feeds.role_note: Recent indicators. A mapped country is the DB-IP country of an IP literal in the indicator, not a victim.

feeds.name: abuse.ch Feodo Tracker
feeds.licence: Free to use with attribution to abuse.ch. See the blocklist terms.
feeds.role_note: Botnet C2 addresses. The country is the one Feodo publishes for that address, not a victim country.

feeds.name: Spamhaus DROP and EDROP
feeds.licence: Use only under the Spamhaus DROP terms. This cache attributes Spamhaus and does not resell the lists.
feeds.role_note: Listed networks. Country is the DB-IP country of the network address, not a victim country. The file has one last-modified time, not a timestamp per network, so these rows are left out of the 24 hour chart.

feeds.name: SANS ISC DShield
feeds.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Attribute SANS Technology Institute, Internet Storm Center. Do not resell.
feeds.role_note: Source addresses reported to DShield sensors, grouped by the country of the source. The target number in the API is a destination-address count, not a target country. SANS describes the country table as about the last 30 days and does not stamp each row. SANS ISC InfoCon at fetch time: green.

feeds.name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
feeds.licence: US government catalog. Public domain. Not a geographic attack feed.
feeds.role_note: Vulnerabilities CISA lists as known to be exploited. They are not placed on the globe.

kev.name: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev.summary: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

kev.name: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

kev.name: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

kev.name: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
kev.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

kev.name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
kev.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

kev.name: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
kev.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

kev.name: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
kev.summary: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

kev.name: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
kev.summary: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

kev.name: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
kev.summary: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

kev.name: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
kev.summary: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vul...

kev.name: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev.summary: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

kev.name: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
kev.summary: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

kev.name: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
kev.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

kev.name: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
kev.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

kev.name: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
kev.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

kev.name: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev.summary: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

kev.name: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
kev.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

kev.name: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
kev.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

kev.name: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
kev.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

kev.name: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
kev.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

kev.name: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
kev.summary: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

kev.name: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
kev.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

kev.name: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
kev.summary: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.
